about: Keeper's accounts contract vectors (syncular/README.md, Domains and the map; story 114.2). Every implementation reproduces each entry: roles is vocabulary.json's roles; barrier_reads[] is whether each barrier state admits, a state the contract does not have reading as closed; discovery[] bodies of GET /databases parse, and serialise back to want (an entry field a parser does not know is dropped, an absent optional stays absent, an entry whose kind or files_writes the parser does not know is skipped); discovery_refusals[] do not parse; capability_classes and grant_modes are an agent grant's closed word sets (story 114.6); admin_requests[] parse and serialise back to json exactly, an agent grant's capability as given; admin_request_refusals[] do not parse and the server answers them with refusal; command_refusals[] parse and the map's own rules refuse them with refusal, given the map named in map (domains listed, people, and the credential file's agents); command_applications[] parse and the map's own rules apply them, given the map named in map holding the agent grants listed in before, leaving the agent grants listed in after (stories 114.3, 114.6); admin_answers[] and map_views[] parse and serialise back to json exactly, a map view's agent_grants present only when a grant exists; refusals[] is every code the contract adds, with its HTTP status (null: a commit refusal).
